reports.title: Target Hospitality Announces Third Quarter 2026 Results Reflecting Execution at Scale and Building Momentum on Continued Strategic Transformation

guidance.heading: Full Year 2026 Financial Outlook
section: Target’s year-to-date performance and continued execution across its rapidly expanding WHS contract portfolio reinforce the Company’s confidence in its full-year 2026 outlook, which it is reaffirming today. The outlook reflects the growing contributions of recently awarded WHS contracts as these communities scale, supported by strong unit economics and disciplined operational execution across the broader portfolio.
